subtasks.title: Implement and export slugify
subtasks.goal:
Add ASCII slug normalization using named ESM exports and the existing semicolon-free style.
New src/slug.mjs: absent → exported function slugify(text), returning text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').
src/index.mjs: version-only export → preserve export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
Keep test/slug.test.mjs and package.json unchanged; add no dependencies or tests. Run both supplied validation commands.
